source_scope: Local M8-E narrow package build; journal and archived effective configuration independently confirm expiry/session behavior. No heap attribution is claimed.

mechanism.163-180: Each successful login creates a new session and reports count
mechanism.190-210: Zero requested/global expiry produces infinite expiry
mechanism.230-239: Logout deletes all sessions for the user
mechanism.242-258: Infinite-expiry sessions stay valid; finite expired sessions removed on check

conclusion: Repeated harness login with keep-session produces retained session objects by design. Their total memory footprint and role in the delayed RSS ramp were not measured. Not a proven continuing leak or a complete benign explanation.
